survey.title: Memory in the Age of AI Agents: A Survey — Forms, Functions and Dynamics

token_level.flat_1d: Linear sequences/bags: chunks, trajectories, dialogue logs, experience pools
token_level.planar_2d: Single-layer structured: graphs, trees, tables (knowledge graphs, temporal KGs, reasoning trees)
token_level.hierarchical_3d: Multi-layer with cross-layer links: pyramids, multi-level graphs (community detection, recursive clustering)

parametric.internal: Pre-train / mid-train / post-train weight updates (SFT, FT, KL-tuning, RL)

latent.generate: Auxiliary modules synthesize embeddings (Gist, Titans, MemGen, MemoryLLM, M+)
latent.reuse: Direct KV-cache propagation (Memorizing Transformers, LONGMEM, Memory3)
latent.transform: Compress/restructure existing latent state (H2O, SnapKV, PyramidKV, RazorAttention)

factual_memory.description: Declarative knowledge base for consistency, coherence, adaptability

subtypes.user_factual: Identity, preferences, routines, commitments (dialogue coherence, goal consistency)
subtypes.environment_factual: Document states, resource availability, shared multi-agent knowledge (knowledge persistence, shared access)

experiential_memory.description: Procedural/strategic knowledge for continual learning and self-evolution

subtypes.case_based: Raw trajectories/solutions with high fidelity (Memento, ExpeL, JARVIS-1)
subtypes.strategy_based: Insights, workflows, patterns (Reflexion, AWM, Buffer of Thoughts, Agent KB)
subtypes.skill_based: Executable code, functions, APIs, MCPs (Voyager, SkillWeaver, CREATOR, ToolGen)
subtypes.hybrid: Integrates multiple levels (ExpeL + insights, Agent KB workflows + cases, ChemAgent, MemVerse)

working_memory.description: Capacity-limited, dynamically controlled scratchpad for active context management

subtypes.multi_turn: State consolidation (MemAgent, ReSum), hierarchical folding (HiAgent, Context-Folding), cognitive planning (SayPlan, KARMA)

formation.semantic_summarization: Incremental (MemGPT, Mem1, MemAgent) vs Partitioned (MemoryBank, ReadAgent, LightMem)
formation.knowledge_distillation: Factual (TiM, RMM, MemGuide) vs Experiential (AWM, Memp, ExpeL, R2D2, H2R, Memory-R1)
formation.structured_construction: Entity-level (KGT, Mem0g, GraphRAG, Zep) vs Chunk-level (RAPTOR, MemTree, A-MEM, G-Memory)
formation.latent_representation: Textual (MemoryLLM, M+, MemGen) vs Multimodal (CoMEM, Mem2Ego, KARMA)
formation.parametric_internalization: Knowledge (MEND, ROME, MEMIT, CoLoR) vs Capability (ToolFormer, Memory Decoder)

evolution.consolidation: Local (RMM), Cluster-level (PREMem, EverMemOS, TiM, CAM), Global (MOOM, Matrix, AgentFold)
evolution.updating: External (MemGPT → Zep temporal → MOOM dual-phase → Mem-α RL), Model Editing (ROME, MEMORYLLM, M+)
evolution.forgetting: Time-based (MemGPT, stochastic decay), Frequency-based (XMem LFU, KARMA Bloom, MemOS LRU), Importance-driven (VLN clustering, Livia emotion, TiM LLM-judge)

retrieval.timing_intent: Automated timing (MemGen latent triggers, ComoRAG fast-slow), Automated intent (MemOS MemScheduler, H-MEM hierarchical routing)
retrieval.query_construction: Decomposition (Visconde, ChemAgent, PRIME planner, Agent KB teacher-student), Rewriting (HyDE, MemoRAG, MemGuide, Rewrite-Retrieve-Read)
retrieval.strategies: Lexical (BM25), Semantic (dense embeddings), Graph (HippoRAG PageRank, CAM LLM-steered, Zep temporal), Generative, Hybrid
retrieval.post_processing: Re-ranking/filtering (LLM evaluators, Q-learning Memento), Aggregation/compression (ComoRAG Integration Agent, G-Memory role-customization)

procedural_memory_gap.core_issue: Skill-based memory is the 'active execution substrate' but most systems stall at case/strategy level; bridging to executable, verifiable skills remains underdeveloped
evidence: Proced-Mem benchmark (ICLR 2026): 30-42% MAP drop on novel contexts (generalization cliff)
Visual similarity trap: screenshots help coarse retrieval but fail at fine-grained procedural matching
Survey Table 1: 60+ token-level methods but only ~15 explicitly skill-based (code/API/MCP)
Hybrid memory (Sec 4.2.4) noted as 'increasingly adopted' but still early
missing_pieces: End-to-end RL for skill synthesis from trajectories (only Voyager, Darwin Godel Machine, SkillWeaver)
Procedural memory consolidation: case → strategy → skill pipeline automation
Verification/execution feedback loops for skill refinement

other_gaps: Retrieval-centric → Generative memory shift (Sec 7.1): current systems retrieve; future must synthesize context-adaptive representations
Manual → Automated memory management (Sec 7.2): hand-crafted thresholds/rules don't generalize; need tool-based, self-optimizing architectures
RL-free → RL-driven memory (Sec 7.3): only partial RL integration today; full lifecycle RL control needed
Unimodal → Omnimodal memory (Sec 7.4): no system provides truly unified multimodal support
Isolated → Shared multi-agent memory (Sec 7.5): write contention, role-aware access, learning-driven sync unsolved
Trustworthy memory (Sec 7.7): privacy (leakage via prompt attacks), explainability (traceable access paths), hallucination robustness

agent_memory_vs_llm_memory.relationship: Agent memory subsumes most historical 'LLM memory' work (MemGPT, MemoryBank)
agent_memory_vs_llm_memory.distinction: LLM-internal memory (KV cache, architectural modifications for long context, RWKV/Mamba) stays outside agent memory scope

agent_memory_vs_rag.overlap: Shared engineering stacks (vector indices, graph retrieval, semantic search)
agent_memory_vs_rag.distinction: RAG = static external knowledge for single-task augmentation (HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue); Agent memory = persistent, self-evolving, cross-task, environment-driven (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, GAIA)
agent_memory_vs_rag.boundary_blur: Agentic RAG (Self-RAG, PlanRAG) and HippoRAG claimed by both communities

agent_memory_vs_context_engineering.overlap: Working memory mechanisms (compression, summarization, token pruning, rolling summaries) are shared primitives
agent_memory_vs_context_engineering.distinction: Context engineering = resource management paradigm (structural organization, interface correctness, MCP, syntactic validity); Agent memory = cognitive paradigm (persistent knowledge, experiential evolution, identity coherence, semantic consolidation)
agent_memory_vs_context_engineering.relationship: Context engineering provides the external scaffolding; agent memory constitutes the internal substrate

procedural_memory.title: PROCED-MEM: Benchmarking Procedural Memory Retrieval in Language Agents Across Domains
procedural_memory.key_finding: 30-42% MAP degradation on novel contexts; visual features rank first at coarse but last at fine-grained procedural matching

procedural_memory.title: LLMs Can't Play Hangman: On the Necessity of a Private Working Memory for Language Agents
procedural_memory.authors: Davide Baldelli, Ali Parviz, Amal Zouaq, Sarath Chandar
procedural_memory.key_finding: Impossibility theorem: public chat history cannot preserve secrecy+consistency in Private State Interactive Tasks; explicit private working memory required

graph_memory_ontology.authors: Shuo Ji, Yibo Li, Bryan Hooi

episodic_latent_memory.key_finding: ReSuME: surprise-gated memory via SAE reconstruction error; unsupervised, model-internal signal for memory writing

episodic_latent_memory.title: Entropic Memory: A Thermodynamics-Inspired Consolidation Mechanism for Lifelong Agent Learning

dual_memory_experiential_frameworks.factual_memory: Maps to semantic/declarative memory in dual-process models (DCPM, D-Mem, CALMem); user+environment factual ≈ world knowledge + user profile
dual_memory_experiential_frameworks.experiential_memory: Maps to episodic/procedural memory; survey's 4-level abstraction (case→strategy→skill→hybrid) formalizes the 'experiential abstraction' pipeline from ERL/experience compression literature
dual_memory_experiential_frameworks.working_memory: Aligns with capacity-limited workspace in dual-memory; survey adds interaction-dynamics taxonomy (single/multi-turn, consolidation/folding/planning)
dual_memory_experiential_frameworks.dynamics_cycle: Formation/Evolution/Retrieval = Encoding/Consolidation/Retrieval cycle in dual-memory; survey adds parametric internalization and latent representation as formation paths
novel_contributions: 3-axis taxonomy (Forms × Functions × Dynamics) unifies fragmented literature
Explicit treatment of parametric and latent memory forms alongside token-level
RL integration as path to fully automated memory management (Sec 7.3)
Procedural memory gap formally identified via skill-based memory taxonomy
Trustworthy memory as first-class design principle (privacy, explainability, hallucination)
Multi-agent shared memory as distinct research frontier

repackaging_vs_novel.repackaging: Dual-process memory → Factual/Experiential/Working; Episodic/Semantic/Procedural → Case/Strategy/Skill; Consolidation cycles → Formation/Evolution/Retrieval
genuinely_novel: Dynamics taxonomy with 5 formation ops, 3 evolution mechanisms, 4 retrieval stages
Production gap analysis: procedural memory cliff, generative vs retrieval shift
RL-driven memory as end-to-end learnable subsystem
Omnimodal and multi-agent shared memory as explicit frontiers
OS-like trustworthy memory abstractions (segmented, versioned, auditable)
